[note] outline: No single colour owns the silhouette edge on 'Layer 1', so this sprite is not outlined. That is a valid style — just keep it consistent. on 'Layer 1' frame 1
[note] banding: A 56-pixel straight boundary between #2679b3 and #90989a on 'Layer 1'. Let the edge wander, or dither part of it, so it reads as a surface rather than a contour line. at (32,57) on 'Layer 1' frame 1
